spec.query: SELECT "tx_hash", "expected_spread_bps", "realized_spread_bps", "gas_actual_fee_bps", "lot_size_usd", "fill_size_usd", "expected_pnl_post_fill", "tx_block", "is_cefi_trigger", "is_defi_trigger", "edge_bps", "block_number_pre_fill", "time_since_latest_block_pre_fill_micros"  / 1000 AS "Millis since latest block", "block_adjustment_bps_pre_fill", "ema_adjustment_bps_pre_fill", "defi_actual_fill_price" FROM "default_defi_retention"."rust_defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_post_trade" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND "nonce_too_low"::tag = '0' AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "contract_error"::tag, "is_buy"::tag, "pool"::tag ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100000

SELECT count("tx_hash") FROM "default_defi_retention"."rust_defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_post_trade" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(6h) fill(null)

spec.title: Availability
spec.description: Right now this is in active development stage, so it's entirely possible that I stopped the strategy to experiment. So don't get concerned if availability is 0 for some time! :)

spec.query: SELECT last("pnl") FROM "default"."acct_lvl_daily_pnl" WHERE (('eth' =~ /^$asset$/ AND "label" =~ /^SLN--DEFI--DEFI--DEFICEFI--ETH$/ AND "level" =~ /^(0|1|2|3|4)$/ AND "label"::tag != 'SLN--DEFI') OR ('btc' =~ /^$asset$/ AND "label" =~ /^SLN--DEFI--DEFI--DEFICEFI--BTC$/ AND "level" =~ /^(0|1|2|3|4)$/ AND "label"::tag != 'SLN--DEFI') OR ('dot' =~ /^$asset$/ AND "label" =~ /^SLN--DEFI--DEFI--DEFICEFI--DOT$/ AND "level" =~ /^(0|1|2|3|4)$/ AND "label"::tag != 'SLN--DEFI') OR ('arb' =~ /^$asset$/ AND "label" =~ /^SLN--DEFI--DEFI--DEFICEFI--ARB$/ AND "level" =~ /^(0|1|2|3|4)$/ AND "label"::tag != 'SLN--DEFI')) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label", "level" fill(none)

SELECT median("defi_base_balance_whole_pre_fill") FROM "default_defi_retention"."rust_defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "base_asset"::tag =~ /^$asset$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "pool"::tag fill(previous)

SELECT last("positionAsFloat") 
FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategySignal" 
WHERE ('eth' =~ /^$asset$/ AND "strategy"::tag = 'ARB_V2_DEFI_DEFICEFI_ETH_BDM_USDT_Q|H') OR ('btc' =~ /^$asset$/ AND "strategy"::tag = 'ARB_V2_DEFI_DEFICEFI_BTC_BDM_USDT_Q|H') OR ('dot' =~ /^$asset$/ AND "strategy"::tag = 'ARB_V2_DEFI_DEFICEFI_DOT_BDM_USDT_Q|H') OR ('arb' =~ /^$asset$/ AND "strategy"::tag = 'ARB_V2_DEFI_DEFICEFI_ARB_BDM_USDT_Q|H')
AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($__interval) 
fill(previous)

SELECT last("positionAsFloat") 
FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategySignal" 
WHERE ('eth' =~ /^$asset$/ AND "strategy"::tag = 'ARB_V2_DEFI_DEFICEFI_ETH_BDM_USDT_Q|H') OR ('btc' =~ /^$asset$/ AND "strategy"::tag = 'ARB_V2_DEFI_DEFICEFI_BTC_BDM_USDT_Q|H') OR ('dot' =~ /^$asset$/ AND "strategy"::tag = 'ARB_V2_DEFI_DEFICEFI_DOT_BDM_USDT_Q|H') OR ('arb' =~ /^$asset$/ AND "strategy"::tag = 'ARB_V2_DEFI_DEFICEFI_ARB_BDM_USDT_Q|H')
AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($__interval) 
fill(previous)
